g.text: owned by the aggregate (composition or plain association)
reference to another aggregate by identity only, never by object
«id» marks the identity attribute. Business identities use
(Usernames, SKUs, Emails, Names) or internal Long IDs. AuthSession uses an unpredictable UUID and references its owner by Username.
